title: E-FRC-0193: stimulated emission on the husk: each mode of the exactly linear husk leapfrog oscillates at one...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0193 in the gauge arena: stimulated emission on the husk: each mode of the exactly linear husk leapfrog oscillates at one frequency at every amplitude, a harmonic oscillator, so a stand-in emitter in light holding n photons per mode near its line decays at (n + 1) times its spontaneous rate, where modes that hold one quantum at most block it.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
